title: Import
description: Catalog imports from Excel workbooks and CSV files: preview every change before it is applied, and undo an import afterwards.
newDescription: Upload a supplier's workbook or CSV file. Nothing changes in the catalog until you apply the preview.
allOrNothingHint: Apply nothing while any row has errors. Turned off, rows with errors are skipped and everything else is applied.

upload.title: File
upload.description: An Excel workbook (.xlsx) or a CSV file (UTF-8, separated by ; or ,). Pictures placed over the rows of a workbook become the variants' images.
upload.profileHint: A saved mapping, e.g. for this supplier: the preview follows at once. Without one, you map the columns next.

mapping.profileDescription: Load a saved mapping, or save this one to reuse it for the next file of this supplier.
mapping.deleteProfileMessage: Delete the saved mapping "{{name}}"? Imports made with it keep their mapping.
mapping.sourceDescription: Which sheet and rows to read. The first rows below the header row are shown as they will be read.
mapping.headerRowHint: 0 for a file without column headers
mapping.noRows: No data rows below the header row.
mapping.kindDescription: Every product needs a system (KNX, Zigbee, …) and a category. Fix them for the whole file, or read them from a column.
mapping.productTypeHint: Systems are never created by an import.
mapping.productTypeValueHint: Matched like a cell, e.g. zigbee
mapping.categoryHint: Defines the attributes of the products
mapping.categoryValueHint: Matched like a cell, e.g. Gateways
mapping.createMissingCategoriesHint: Categories the file names but the catalog lacks are created, with a text attribute for each mapped attribute. Off, their rows are errors.
mapping.columnsDescription: What each column of the file fills in. Columns left as "Not imported" are ignored. One row is one variant; rows with the same model number form one product.
mapping.noColumns: The file has no columns in this row.
mapping.imageAnyColumnHint: The first picture placed over a row becomes the variant's image; rows without one get the product's first picture.
mapping.imageColumnChosen: A column is imported as picture: its pictures are used.
mapping.constantsDescription: A value for every row instead of a column, e.g. a name or an attribute all products share.
mapping.extrasDescription: Entries of the saved mapping that fit no column of this file shown above: a column this file lacks, or a second field from the same column.
mapping.noSheet: Choose one of the file's sheets to see its columns.
mapping.previewingRows_one: Comparing {{count}} data row with the catalog …
mapping.previewingRows_other: Comparing {{count}} data rows with the catalog. Large files take a moment.
mapping.previewingHint: Comparing the rows with the catalog. Large files take a moment.
mapping.profileDiffers: The mapping differs from the saved mapping "{{name}}". The preview uses the mapping as shown here.
mapping.replaceMessage: Load the saved mapping "{{name}}"? It replaces the changes you made to the mapping.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Previewed on {{date}}: what the import of {{rows}} rows changes. Nothing has been written yet.
preview.applyDescription: Writes exactly the changes above in one step. You can undo the import afterwards.
preview.blocked_one: {{count}} row has errors: with "All or nothing" the import cannot be applied. Fix the file, or turn the option off to skip the row.
preview.blocked_other: {{count}} rows have errors: with "All or nothing" the import cannot be applied. Fix the file, or turn the option off to skip these rows.
preview.blockedShort: Rows have errors: with "All or nothing" nothing can be applied.

items.title: Changes
items.description: Every category, product and variant of the file, and what is deactivated because the file no longer lists it.
items.searchHint: Model number, SKU, name or row
items.noChanges: Nothing changes: every item of the file is as in the catalog.

issues.title: Errors and warnings
issues.description: {{errors}}, {{warnings}}. Rows with errors are not imported; warnings do not stop a row.
issues.none: The file has no errors or warnings.

failed.title: The import failed and was rolled back: nothing was changed.
failed.hint: Check the mapping or the file, then preview again.

result.undone: The import was undone on {{date}}: the catalog is as before it.
result.title: Result
result.undoneDescription: What the import had written before it was undone.
result.undoMessage: Undo everything this import changed? Created products, variants and categories are deleted, changed ones get their previous values back and deactivated ones are reactivated.

changes.title: Change log
changes.description: Every change the import wrote ({{count}}), in the order it wrote them.

delete.title: Delete import
delete.message: Delete the import of "{{name}}"? Its preview, errors and change log are deleted; the catalog does not change.
delete.applied: This import is applied: undo it first, then delete it.

columns.title: New columns – what do they mean?
columns.description_one: {{count}} column matches no catalog field yet. Say what it means: just information, an existing catalog field, or a new one SnapFlow can use for its checks.
columns.description_other: {{count}} columns match no catalog field yet. Say what each means: just information, an existing catalog field, or a new one SnapFlow can use for its checks.
columns.label: Label
columns.optionsHint: Type a choice and press Enter.
columns.optionsFixed: This meaning needs exactly these choices.
columns.productTypesHint: None ticked: the meaning applies to every system.
columns.knownDescription: These attribute columns are already known.

link.will_link: will be linked to field {{field}} in {{category}}
link.type_mismatch: stays unlinked in {{category}}: other value type
